 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Martínez Valero hosts a demanding LaLiga clash between Elche and Valencia this Sunday.
 Martín Anselmi's Elche head into the game buoyed by a 3-0 thrashing of Rayo Vallecano, extending their unbeaten run to four matches with three clean sheets, although Fer Niño remains a doubt. Meanwhile, Javier Aguirre's Valencia are struggling to find their way: still mired in the relegation zone with just one win, they urgently need a response after losing to Villarreal. Thomas Lemar and Javi Guerra promise a decisive battle in midfield.
